experiment.event_matching_exclusion_policy: Ineligible scenarios remain in per-scenario results and diagnostic metrics, but are excluded from primary aggregate event-matching scores.

metric_definitions.candidate_matching: Scores all method predictions against ground truth, regardless of interpretation state.
metric_definitions.definitive_prediction_detection: Scores only predictions selected by the declared method-specific definitive-state policy.
metric_definitions.interpretation_state_accuracy: Compares normalized predicted states with explicit expected states for matched ground-truth events. Unmatched and unscored events are reported separately.
metric_definitions.interpretation_state_aliases: Baseline states are mapped to canonical evaluation states; original prediction labels are preserved.

experiment.scope: Synthetic benchmark results; they do not establish performance on real-world investigations.
